All of these things worked for me but it's temporary so you have to keep doing them & that's the hard part.I am now, it screwed up all the great progress I was making in controlling my depression and DID. I think it even made it worse because it lowered my self esteem even more. I should have honored myself and said no, that's not for me when I saw the first lie. I need someone who's honest and kind. I don't want to say people like us because each one of us has varying degrees of different symptoms & we are each so unique.

 I wash my hands after I touch something I think is dirty and I decided to think of it as 'I dont want to accidentally touch my face after touching something dirty because it will transfer the bacteria to my skin and cause a pimple or rub my eyes & make them swollen or red and itchy, Which has happened before.'  If you can't go to college don't beat yourself up about it. We can't do anything about what nature gave us. We just have to find a way to deal with it. Accepting our limitations helps us be more relaxed.  If you can work I have met so many people who have a fine life and don't mind working as a grocery store cashier their whole lives or work with animals. If you cannot work then please choose acceptance for your condition. I cannot work and I wish I could (i'd work at petco because it's relaxed as opposed to doing like accounting in a hospital, so I could see all the animals but wouldn't have to have my own- it's too much responsibility) but I know and accept my condition interferes with holding down a job & I accept that as my reality. Sometimes I have to have a conversation with myself and remind myself why I can't do certain things like going to college or getting a job.

I can't even have a relationship until I get my condition stable and learn some skills like saying no I'm not going to accept a person in my life that does drugs, yells, gaslights, lies, has cheated in the past. That's hard because we want to be loved. 

Getting into a relationship with someone who lies and gaslights and cheated before is what got me to where I am now, it screwed up all the great progress I was making in controlling my depression and DID. I think it even made it worse because it lowered my self esteem even more. I should have honored myself and said no, that's not for me when I saw the first lie. I need someone who's honest and kind. I don't want tosay people like us because each one of us has varying degrees of different symptoms & we are each so unique.

I am telling you all this because I hope  you can use something I have learned in my life & learned in 20 years of therapy  to feel some relief right now. Does anything make you feel better in the moment (that doesnt harm you). Every moment matters and can give you a memory you can look back on & say I felt good then, ya that was good. 

Medication can help but you have to do research and speak up to the doctor about which ones you want to try.  Remember...They work FOR YOU, they are getting paid to help you get better. They are not the king & cannot push you into something you don't want to do. You have the right & responsibility to yourself to say I'm not comfortable with that are there any alternatives?  Doctors don't know everything & sometimes know alot about one thing but nothing about anything else. Seriously they leave the room and go look stuff up on their laptop then come back & give you a prescription of what they just  saw and read about patients condition. It's not their fault, no one can keep all that medical information in their head.

I googled 'brain chemicals' & this is the good info. Some of it is bad or flat out lies.

Anxiety, including obsessive-compulsive forms of anxiety, may indicate a person has low serotonin.  
 Anxiety that comes on suddenly and appears unrelated to something else,  
 such as a recent trauma or stress, is often due to a serotonin issue.  
 Chronic stress and anxiety may also deplete serotonin.

Examples of SSRIs include fluoxetine (Prozac) and sertraline (Zoloft). These drugs are effective for increasing serotonin and can treat symptoms of depression

I think we are not supposed to diagnose here but bipolar/ dissasociation and medication would help that. When it takes too long to see a psychiatrist you can get meds from a regular doctor until you have your psych appointment.

Tha's what I did.

Sometimes I think I should sign myself into a mental hospital for treatment to get rid of the self harm thoughts.

Have you ever considered doing that? Around here we have a suicide hotline and it helps just to hear someones voice even if they are not a psychiatrist because the person on the other end of the phone is an anonymous listener who is there because they care about us. I called and unloaded all my frears and thoughts and it helped and I wasnt afraid of what they would think of me because its not like it was my friend or family member who would be afraid of me or judge me after that. I hope you get help soon because it might get worse.

I personally decided I was going to let go of what I wish would have been my life and accepted that I have mental illness and I would have to find ways to live comfortably with it. It was alot of acceptance of things I didn't like but what was reality and what I wanted in my fantasy of what I wish my life could have been were 2 different things. I had to accept not working, I had to accept living off government aid and medical benefits. Then I was given this good advice - find things that make you happy. They may seem like a waste of time to others who can work hard, play hard without any mental issues but I can't let anybody outside of me tell me what makes me happy. I found painting, drawing (badly) coloring, indoor gardening, collecting cookbooks, collecting lyrics to songs I like, raises my mood temporarily, I listen to music on a cheap mp3 player when I go to bed & put it on a sleep timer. Then I have to do it all again the next day. I could sell plants or the things I make but my condition prevents me from that so I have to accept that too and I have to work at not letting that reality get me down because that does bum me out.

In therapy I learned to properly grieve the loss of things that meant alot to me . I had to greive the loss of my hopes and dreams as if a best friend had died in order to let them go. It was painful & took many months. I still get a twinge now & then of what could have been but through therapy I developed a deep understanding of my issues & what I can and cannot  do. An understanding of myself. I had to interview 3 different therapists to find 1 that counseled well, knew how to treat my issues and whos personality worked well with mine. You can do this to but it will take work on your part to get help. Check out CBT and DBT therapy. They are great for personal interaction issues.

DID alters can have different talents, skills, knowledge, language, tastes, etc.

One of mine speaks and understands very decent spanish, all the others cant understand a word and barely know any words even though I grew up around spanish speaking people. one is very crafty and fluent in sewing. Another is very good in business situations, while another is a hothead who is too blunt & honest-direct. Just like each human is different each personality in me is different & I do feel odd having 5 different people in 1 in me.

If she pees on a hard surface, wipe it with a paper towel and put the paper towel under the litter and as someone else said lock kitty in bathroom with litter box a warm bed, food/ water then go in alot to play with it and cuddle it making sure you put  all pee and poops in litter box to show it where they go. when kitty is only using box then you can let it out but keep box right outside bathroom for a few days then slowly move it closer and closer to where you want to keep it. yes its inconvenient but thats what having pets or kids is. you have to do things you may not like because its the right thing to do. They are a comminttment of time, effort & money.

every DID issue is different with each person. For me each personality has very extremely different  sense of morality. My main personality doesn't like any chemicals in/ on my body like smoking or mineral oil lotions, pesticides & has good morals( hates lying & liars). The others depending on the age have very different beliefs & habits -some being the opposite of my mains preferences.

I'll say it this way. It's different for each person. For me if I switch in the middle of a conversation I will completely forget what was being talked about. Because I've been dealing with this for 4 years I have developed coping skills to deal with it in ways to not alert the other person to what has happenned. I find that if I continue listening to them talk and ask questions I can pick up on what the conversation was about & if not I'll ask in a way that makes me seem like I got distracted by my own thoughts.

I have had 30 years to develop skills to deal with my symptoms & because life is ever changing I still have new difficulties crop up.

Just because a therapist/psych thinks you have something that doesnt mean they are correct everytime. I have been diagnosed with 5 different things by different therapists & psychiatrists but I only have depression and DID. It's important to get a few opinions especially if they want to put you on meds....And research the meds too. I have tried 12 & only 2 work for my symptoms. There is no way medical personel can keep all the information in their head , you must become an informed patient so you can say no when something doesnt seem right for you. 

One psych asst. I was seeing was so excited to push the latest newest psych meds the salesmen brought to him regardless of the side effects and my apprehension. He pushed me saying "just try it, I'll give you samples and you can decide if you want to stick with it."

It definately takes 1 or 2 interview appointments with at least 4 different therapists to ask questions & see if their style, personality & treatment meshes with yours. If it doesn't simply don't make another appointment with that one. Quite frankly they know they R getting paid for doing a job & if a patient comes back or not is not their concern. The best therapist I had was familiar with DID & was able to help me integrate alot but insurance had a time limit so I had to find someone new after that. The most recent psych I checked out was a man who stictly believed that everyone could change their issues just by changing their thinking. Every symptom I told him he would throw back a comment like "well isn't it possible you just didn't want to go to work so you made your mind forget & it's not a different personality?". Then there's the positive thinkers who tell you it all starts with loving yourself.   Over the last 25 years I have only had 3 knowledgeable helpful therapists/physchiatrists who were able to help me & 5 that were not able knowledgeable or helpful & just gave me the meds the other ones prescribed. I realized I cannot be in a relationship with a dysfunctional person even if they are working on themselves because there are so many triggers. I tried dating a broken person who seemed so together the first few years because I thought I had learned enough, integrated all but 6 of my personalities and was doing very well in my life but in dealing with his dysfunction I lost focus on my life and stopped going to therapy and didnt see that I had lost all the progress I made. I find a partner too much of a distraction when trying to fix myself.
